name: _txPathFix
detail: Source contains a concrete path canonicalization implementation with separator normalization, dot-segment removal, bounded output, and a returned destination pointer.

name: _txPathFormat
detail: Source contains a concrete formatter that supplies the default dot path, appends a separator, and delegates to txPathFix.

name: _txPathMake
detail: Source contains a concrete path-maker implementation delegating through the formatting and fixing path.

name: _txPathDirEnd
detail: Source contains a concrete directory-end search returning the character after the final separator or null.

name: _txPathFileStart
detail: Source contains a concrete file-start search returning the character after the final separator or the original path.

name: _txPathExtStart
detail: Source contains a concrete extension-start search on the file portion of the path.

name: _txPathFile
detail: Source contains a concrete bounded file-component extraction implementation.

name: _txPathExt
detail: Source contains a concrete bounded extension-component extraction implementation.

name: _txPathDir
detail: Source contains a concrete bounded directory-component extraction implementation.

name: _txPathName
detail: Source contains a concrete bounded filename-without-extension extraction implementation.

name: _txPathNormalize
detail: Source contains a concrete in-place path normalization implementation.
